observations.detail: The narration accurately reflects the comic panels shown on screen.
Visual transitions between panels are smooth and maintain the comic book aesthetic.
The narrator's energy is consistent and engaging throughout the documentary.
Audio quality is clear with no noticeable glitches or background noise.
Captions are legible, though they display multiple words per frame instead of the requested single word.
The story concludes effectively with the final panel and narration.

ignored_editorial_issues: The caption word count consistently exceeds the specified limit of 1 word per caption.
